_comment: Rebuilt from the real Skill Focus (X) feat list in feats.json — every genuine Haze skill has a matching Skill Focus variant, so this list is exhaustive and confirmed, not guessed. Alchemy, Appraise, Bluff, Ride, Intimidate, and Swim were previously listed as 'presumed unchanged from vanilla' but have NO matching Skill Focus feat anywhere in the real data — removed for lack of proof. If any of these turn out to be real, the fix is re-adding them here once confirmed.

skills.name: Acrobatics
skills.description: Used in several skill checks and to avoid attacks of opportunity; can also provide additional AC.

skills.name: Animal Empathy
skills.description: Primary skill for interacting with animals — required for the Animal Companion System.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Maintains a spell during an attack of opportunity or when casting defensively.

skills.name: Disable Device
skills.description: Used to disable traps and other devices, or on DM request.

skills.name: Discipline
skills.description: Resists combat maneuvers like Disarm and Knockdown.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Determines healing amount and success with healing kits; also used for cause-of-death or other DM-requested checks.

skills.name: Hide
skills.description: Used together with Move Silently to determine stealth check success.

skills.name: Influence
skills.description: Determines success/failure of most social interactions; also affects NPC shop prices.

skills.name: Knowledge: Arcane
skills.description: One of five confirmed Knowledge sub-skills (replacing the old single Lore skill).

skills.name: Knowledge: Architecture
skills.description: One of five confirmed Knowledge sub-skills (replacing the old single Lore skill).

skills.name: Knowledge: General
skills.description: One of five confirmed Knowledge sub-skills (replacing the old single Lore skill).

skills.name: Knowledge: Nature
skills.description: One of five confirmed Knowledge sub-skills (replacing the old single Lore skill).

skills.name: Knowledge: Religion
skills.description: One of five confirmed Knowledge sub-skills (replacing the old single Lore skill).

skills.name: Listen
skills.description: Counters Move Silently; also used to overhear whispers and other in-game events.

skills.name: Move Silently
skills.description: Used together with Hide to determine stealth check success.

skills.name: Open Lock
skills.description: Used with the Theft & Recovery system to access chests and doors. Rogues add sneak attack dice (as d6s) to this roll.

skills.name: Parry
skills.description: Blocks incoming melee attacks from your primary target; succeeding by 5+ grants an attack of opportunity. Changed from Dexterity to an Intelligence-based skill (armor check penalty still applies).

skills.name: Perform
skills.description: Used for Bard Songs and with the Identity System (disguise-related).

skills.name: Pick Pocket
skills.description: Used with the Theft & Recovery system to steal from other players/NPCs, with DM oversight.

skills.name: Search
skills.description: Determines success finding traps, loot, secret paths, and more.

skills.name: Set Device
skills.description: Used to set traps and other devices, or on DM request.

skills.name: Spellcraft
skills.description: Identifies cast spells; also used in the Spellcraft System for Wizards & Sorcerers (spell slot recovery).

skills.name: Spot
skills.description: Counters Hide; also used in examine nodes and other in-game events.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Used in Survival Crafting and to track creatures through an area (with DM help).

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Attempts to lower a target's AC and induce spell failure.

skills.name: Use Magic Device
skills.description: Bypasses requirements for magic items; also used during DM events.

removedSkillsNote: These three no longer exist as skills — crafting now runs through a separate Crafting System (5 primary + 2 secondary crafts, using CXP).
unconfirmedRemovedNote: These were removed from this file because no Skill Focus (X) feat exists for any of them in the real feat export, and no wiki page confirms them either. If you find proof any of these exist, add them back.
